# Policymaker #511, iteration 0102

No owner action is necessary now. I changed `policy/working-memory.md` only. `.session/orders.json` has no orders.

## What changed and why

- Iteration 0101 closed without a failure. Shaper #508 ended in 23 turns. Researcher #509 ended in 25 turns and its change was merged (commit `53816a0`).
- #509 staged POC exit 1 of [delivery.md](../docs/research/poc/delivery.md): the controlled same-version pair. It added five files under `docs/research/poc/pair/`.
- I matched the five current files to the bytes of commit `53816a08feeb89a2747bf63ce8338ea315e06518`. All five are the same.
- [selfcheck.json](../docs/research/poc/pair/selfcheck.json) has `status: passed` and three tool controls. These are results of the author. I did not run the self-check again and I did not review `pair_diff.py`.
- I read [owner-instructions.md](../docs/research/poc/pair/owner-instructions.md) (13 steps, eight VIs and `authoring.md`) and [protocol.md](../docs/research/poc/pair/protocol.md). Only the owner can make the pair in LabVIEW.
- I filed no Owner request. The journal of #508 and the orchestrator skill (line 85) give that request to the shaper of 0102. A second request from me would be a duplicate.
- I placed no orders. With a shaper, the Policymaker orders only the evaluator or the audit. There is no evaluator defect, no audit question, no startup notice (20,454 tokens, ok) and no failed session.
- I made no change to roles, routing, limits or cadence.
- Expected gain: the next sessions keep the staged measurement and its pins. They do not build a second tool, send a duplicate request or compare unrelated VIs. Check: record 0102 and `owner_requests` in the loop state.

Still missing: no real pair exists, no VI was written and no session ran LabVIEW. Native benchmark runs, agent comparisons, native keys, withheld writing cases and version coverage are absent. The tool quality is not measured. A passed tool self-check does not make the benchmark ready and does not accept the method.

## Discoveries

- An empty-text Write erased `journal/working-memory.md` in #508; the shaper rebuilt it. I compared its carried identifiers with the policy memory and they agree, but the actor-framework revision was not checked. Evidence: [#508 report](history/sessions/508/1fbc32c5b6202ce6f73d95ef4c3d8cda36864bc8e2af7d5fcfa4b2cc2e896d7d.md).
- The first Finish of #508 was rejected because the report marker was missing. Each defect occurred one time and was corrected in the session, so I did not change the skill. Evidence: the same report.
- I did not read `docs/perpetua/accepted-limits.md` or the exports manifest in this session. No request and no order needed them.

## What next

- Saved work: section "Controlled-pair staging and iteration 0102" in [policy/working-memory.md](../policy/working-memory.md).
- Next step: read record 0102 and the loop state. If no Owner request for the pair exists and the shaper gave no reason, read `docs/perpetua/accepted-limits.md` and file the request with the 13 steps.
- If a shaper defect of #508 occurs again, add one line to the Done checklist of the orchestrator skill.
- Do not repeat: the byte match of the five pair files, the WM1 audit, the effort study, the closed reviews or the POC research.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
